name: Unit Of Measure 4 Code
definition: Identifies the unit of measure by means of a code. The code is taken from UN/ECE Recommendation 20.

KGM.name: Kilogram
KGM.definition: Basic unit of mass in the SI system, 1000 grams.

EA.name: Each
EA.definition: Unit of count defining the number of items regarded as separate units.

LTN.name: GB Ton
LTN.definition: Measure of weight, in Britain 2240lb (long ton).

MTR.name: Metre
MTR.definition: Unit of length in the metric system, equal to 39.37 inches.

INH.name: Inch
INH.definition: Measure of length equal to 2.54 cm.

LY.name: Yard
LY.definition: Unit of length equal to 3 feet or 0.9144 metre.

GLI.name: GB Gallon
GLI.definition: Unit of volume that is equal to 8 GB pints.

GRM.name: Gram
GRM.definition: Unit of measure that is equal to a 1, 000th of a kilo.

MTK.name: Square Metre
MTK.definition: Measure of a surface, one metre by one metre.

FOT.name: Foot
FOT.definition: Unit of length equal to 1/3 yard.

1A.name: Mile
1A.definition: Unit of length equal to 1, 760 yards.

INK.name: Square Inch
INK.definition: Measure of a surface, one inch by one inch.

FTK.name: Square Foot
FTK.definition: Measure of a surface, one foot by one foot.

MIK.name: Square Mile
MIK.definition: Measure of a surface, one mile by one mile.

ONZ.name: Ounce
ONZ.definition: Unit of weight equal to a sixteenth of a pound.

PTI.name: GB Pint
PTI.definition: Unit of volume that is equal to 568 cubic centimetres.

PT.name: US Pint
PT.definition: Unit of volume that is equal to 473 cubic centimetres.

QTI.name: GB Quart
QTI.definition: Unit of volume that is equal to 2 GB pints.

QT.name: US Quart
QT.definition: Unit of volume that is equal to 2 US pints.

GLL.name: US Gallon
GLL.definition: Unit of volume that is equal to 8 US pints.

MMT.name: Millimetre
MMT.definition: Unit of measure that is a thousandth of one metre.

KTM.name: Kilometre
KTM.definition: Unit of measure that is equal to 1, 000 meters.

YDK.name: Square Yard
YDK.definition: Measure of a surface, one yard by one yard.

MMK.name: Square Millimetre
MMK.definition: Measure of a surface, one millimetre by one millimetre.

CMK.name: Square Centimetre
CMK.definition: Measure of a surface, one centimetre by one centimetre.

KMK.name: Square Kilometre
KMK.definition: Measure of a surface, one kilometre by one kilometre.

MMQ.name: Cubic Millimetre
MMQ.definition: Unit of volume that is equal to one thousandth of a litre.

CLT.name: Centilitre
CLT.definition: Unit of volume that is equal to one hundredth of a litre.

LTR.name: Litre
LTR.definition: Unit of volume that is equal to a thousand cubic centimetres.

LBR.name: Pound
LBR.definition: Unit of weight equal to 0.454 kilograms.

STN.name: US Ton
STN.definition: Measure of weight, in the US 2000lb (short ton).

BLL.name: US Barrel
BLL.definition: Unit of volume equal to 158, 9873 litre.

INQ.name: Cubic Inch
INQ.definition: Measure of a volume, one inch by one inch by one inch.

MTQ.name: Cubic Meter
MTQ.definition: Measure of a volume, one meter by one meter by one meter.

OZI.name: GB Fluid Ounce
OZI.definition: Unit of volume equal to 2, 841 306 centilitre.

OZA.name: US Fluid Ounce
OZA.definition: Unit of volume equal to 2, 957 353 centilitre.

TNE.name: Metric Ton
TNE.definition: Measure of weight, equal to 1000 kilograms.
